{{Quote|When we leave, Vizla will say we are not Mando'ade, and those sheb'urcyin who have forgotten what that word means will agree with her. But if what she has made us is "Mando'ade," then I want no part of it. I will be ash'ad. I will be someone else.|Mirli Lok|<ref name="TOR:TA" />}}
'''Mirli Lok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|warrior]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I convinced Luth to come with me. I showed him we could no longer follow Vizla. We are warriors, we should be taking our fight to Zakuul, not the worthless machines on Darvannis. Vizla may be Mandalore, but Zakuul left no other challengers. Maybe this is her way of thanking them. I know there are others who feel the same, who will come with me too.|Mirli Lok|<ref name="TOR:TA" />}}
Mirli Lok was a survivor<ref name="TOR:TA" /> from the near-devastating loss that [[Clan Lok]] suffered at the hands of the [[Eternal Empire]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], where [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] was killed in battle,<ref name="TOR:TFoMtV">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Fall of Mandalore the Vindicated}}</ref> Mirli and the other survivors of her Clan for a time followed<ref name="TOR:TA" /> the dozen clans that came to be under the leadership of the new Mand'alor, [[Mandalore the Avenger]].<ref name="TOR:KotFE9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=14}}</ref> Mirli grew dissatisfied with the Mandalore's leadership, and had become convinced that it was not in her's and that of her Clan's interests to follow her. When the Clans were planning the [[Raid on Darvannis]], Mirli and her followers abandoned them and they came to the world of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and thus were marked as dar'manda by the rest of the Mandalorians.<ref name="TOR:TA" />

Mirli and her followers would form the [[Ash'ad]], under an agreement with the current ruler of Onderon, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]]. As such, members of her followers could be seen in the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]]. But during the [[Third Galactic War|new galactic war]], things would change drastically for them.<ref name="TOR:TA" /> In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> during the [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|Mission to Onderon]], Mand'alor discovered their location, sending her people in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. Mandalore would later task the [[Alliance Commander]] in hunting down the Ash'ad in the jungles of Onderon. The Outlander eventually found them, and in an attack on their camp, Mirli and her followers were killed, and their sets of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] were stripped from their bodies, sending a message to the clans that Mandalore the Avenger would not tolerate traitors or cowards daring to call themselves Mandalorian.<ref name="TOR:SftD" />

==Equipment==
Mirli wore dark green and brown Mandalorian armor with bone plating, styling herself quite closely to the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]]. She wielded a [[Beskad/Legends|beskad]] and often mixed built in weaponry in her armor such as carbonite freezing, retractable wrist blades, and other gadgets.<ref name="TOR:SftD" />
